reason: A DeepSeek Harness skill plugin that guides agents in framing projects, assessing observability and controllability, establishing feedback loops, handling uncertainty, and applying stopping or delivery rules.

summaries.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供控制论方法指导的技能插件，用于辅助智能体进行项目规划、执行复盘、反馈设计和停止决策。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness skill plugin that helps agents apply cybernetics-inspired methods to project planning, execution reviews, feedback design, and stopping decisions.
